commentBody:
Component 4 agreement (#172): agreed.

Absence of an application import is not evidence that a dependency is unused,
because another dependency can call it. no_usage_detected now needs an
observed import with no matching call on a closed candidate set, an
unimported occurrence alone gives unknown / insufficient_information. Matched
positive evidence still gives usage_detected. This matches Component 4's rule
that incomplete evidence cannot produce a negative.

Checked at 987d50a:
- internal/decision and internal/audit tests pass; go vet and golangci-lint
  clean.
- DetermineState applies the check after positive evidence and adds one
  justification reason (5d); the wording is lint-clean.
- validate.py's occurrence-or-purl match mirrors findingScope.tied(); purl is
  required on findings.
- The three real S5-14 audit cases (#124) give the same decisions on main and
  on this PR (0 no_usage_detected in 93 findings), so S6-10/S6-11 inputs are
  unaffected.

Follow-up on my side: S6-10 (#157) and S6-12 (#159) will describe the
"no direct usage evidence" section as imported-but-not-called only.

Zane (Component 4), 25 October 2026
scope: absence-only dependency evidence cannot support a negative; matched positive evidence retained
pairedReview: not established by this agreement record
